source: Pew Research Center. 2008. "U.S. Religious Landscape Survey."
method: Raised tradition is q50 ("in what religion were you raised") collapsed to five coarse buckets (Protestant of any denomination, Catholic, Mormon, Jewish, Unaffiliated); retention is the share of each raised bucket whose current tradition (RELTRAD) falls in the matching coarse bucket. Continental-US main survey only. Weighted by the dataset's own `weight` variable.
